title: Sorting: ordering data and comparing costs

chapters.title: Insertion sort: building a sorted prefix
facts: Insertion sort shifts elements to place the next item into an already sorted prefix and runs in O(n²) worst-case time
in-place sorting algorithm uses O(1) auxiliary memory

chapters.title: Merge sort: divide and conquer
facts: Merge sort divides the array in half, recursively sorts both halves, and merges them in O(n log n) time
Merge sort is stable but requires O(n) auxiliary space

chapters.title: Quicksort: partitioning around a pivot
facts: Quicksort partitions elements around a pivot value and achieves O(n log n) average time
Quicksort can degrade to O(n²) worst-case time when an unbalanced pivot is chosen repeatedly

chapters.title: Bubble sort: floating elements to the end
facts: Bubble sort repeatedly compares and swaps adjacent out-of-order elements and runs in O(n²) worst-case time

chapters.title: Sorting complexities and trade-offs
facts: Any comparison-based sorting algorithm requires Ω(n log n) comparisons in the worst case
